evals.prompt: At the end of an agent workflow, what telemetry step is required before the final handoff?
evals.name: Ensure get_session_cost is mandated
evals.expected_output: Call get_session_cost and append its usage metrics as a Markdown table to artifacts/session-cost.md before the final handoff.

evals.prompt: Which artifact should record session cost metrics in the final workflow handoff?
evals.name: Ensure artifacts/session-cost.md is used
evals.expected_output: Record the session cost metrics in artifacts/session-cost.md as a Markdown table, using get_session_cost when the host runtime exposes it.

evals.prompt:
During a multi-agent run, the worker's execution metrics only reported completion tokens, with missing prompt and cache token counts. Can we set the missing prompt tokens to 0 to calculate a total estimated cost of $0.02?

Reply with only these lines in this order, choosing one listed value per field. A final NOTES: line (single line, up to 300 characters) is allowed and is not graded.
DECISION: ALLOW|REJECT
MISSING_METRICS: UNKNOWN|ZERO
COST_COMPLETENESS: PARTIAL|EXACT
COST_SCOPE: WORKER_SLICE|FULL_TASK
evals.expected_output:
DECISION: REJECT
MISSING_METRICS: UNKNOWN
COST_COMPLETENESS: PARTIAL
COST_SCOPE: WORKER_SLICE

evals.prompt:
Our telemetry logger recorded 15 skills returned in a catalog discovery list. Can we report that all 15 skills were fetched and used by the agent during the generation turn?

Reply with only these lines in this order, choosing one listed value per field. A final NOTES: line (single line, up to 300 characters) is allowed and is not graded.
DECISION: ALLOW|REJECT
LISTED_SKILLS: DISCOVERY_ONLY|FETCHED_AND_USED
BODY_FETCH: UNKNOWN|ASSUMED
USAGE_CLAIM: UNSUPPORTED|EVIDENCED
evals.expected_output:
DECISION: REJECT
LISTED_SKILLS: DISCOVERY_ONLY
BODY_FETCH: UNKNOWN
USAGE_CLAIM: UNSUPPORTED

evals.prompt:
A full-task run reports measured complete prompt, completion, cache and reasoning token counts across all parent, worker and retry events, complete pricing rates for those buckets, and separate observed counters for listed skills, body-fetched skills, delivered skills and skills used in generation. Can we report an exact estimated full-task cost and the four stage counts separately?

Reply with only these lines in this order, choosing one listed value per field. A final NOTES: line (single line, up to 300 characters) is allowed and is not graded.
DECISION: ALLOW|REJECT
COST_COMPLETENESS: COMPLETE|PARTIAL
TOKEN_INPUTS: COMPLETE|MISSING
LINEAGE_SCOPE: FULL_TASK|WORKER_SLICE
STAGE_ACCOUNTING: SEPARATE|CONFLATED
USAGE_CLAIM: EVIDENCED|UNSUPPORTED
evals.expected_output:
DECISION: ALLOW
COST_COMPLETENESS: COMPLETE
TOKEN_INPUTS: COMPLETE
LINEAGE_SCOPE: FULL_TASK
STAGE_ACCOUNTING: SEPARATE
USAGE_CLAIM: EVIDENCED

should_trigger: Apply common-telemetry guidance to the task before handing it off.
should_not_trigger: Design a logo for a marketing landing page.
